head: codex/5455-stale-owner-provenance
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2] Complete #5455 provenance acceptance remediation
body:
Closes #5540

Completes the retrospective acceptance and closeout recovery for #5455. Trusted Git provenance is now issued only by building all typed binaries from an unchanged, fully clean tracked-and-untracked csdlc-v2 source tree. Direct artifact installs retain content provenance and fail repository coexistence verification. Gate 10A now proves stale artifacts and untracked build inputs fail closed, and exercises implemented-phase approve-design through the installed editor.

Focused proof: Gate 10A 10/10; strict all-target all-feature Clippy passed. The unrelated stale v1 command-guidance owner-lane blocker is tracked separately in #5558.
